# Probity AI

> Open tools, public conformance cases and replayable evidence for checking what agent evidence proves.

## Guides for agents

- [Atlas guide](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/llms.txt): Tools grouped by task, retained runs, claim ledger and pinned releases.
- [Vectors guide](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-vectors/llms.txt): Saved records with known outcomes for testing an agent-evidence verifier.

## Persistent identifiers

- [Predicate types and vocabulary](https://w3id.org/agent-evidence/): Stable URLs for the predicate types and vocabulary terms that records carry.

## Source

- [Organization](https://github.com/probityai): Repositories, releases and issues.
- [agent-evidence-vectors](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors): The conformance corpora, the harness and the GitHub Action.
- [probity](https://github.com/probityai/probity): The verifier, the observer and the MCP server.
